description: This file declares the interface for log backup management, including get/set parameter functions, validation, commit, rollback, and log synchronization functions for a LogBackup object.

methods.name: LogBackup_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for log backup configuration.

methods.name: LogBackup_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value for log backup configuration.

methods.name: LogBackup_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned long parameter value for log backup configuration.

methods.name: LogBackup_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets an unsigned long parameter value for log backup configuration.

methods.name: LogBackup_Validate
methods.description: Validates the current configuration of log backup parameters.

methods.name: LogBackup_Commit
methods.description: Commits the current log backup configuration changes.

methods.name: LogBackup_Rollback
methods.description: Rolls back the log backup configuration to the previous state.

methods.name: get_logbackupcfg
methods.description: Retrieves the current log backup configuration.

methods.name: SyncAndUploadLogs
methods.description: Synchronizes and uploads logs as part of the log backup process.
